text:
Which statement about α-particles and γ-rays is correct?
α-particles are a form of electromagnetic radiation.
A
α-particles penetrate materials more easily than γ-rays.
B
The emission of an α-particle produces a nucleus of a different element.
C
γ-rays are more ionising than α-particles.
D

options.label: A
options.text: α-particles are a form of electromagnetic radiation.

options.label: B
options.text: α-particles penetrate materials more easily than γ-rays.

options.label: C
options.text: The emission of an α-particle produces a nucleus of a different element.

options.label: D
options.text: γ-rays are more ionising than α-particles.

subject: Physics
